title: Backlund, the Iron Sheik and the birth of Hulkamania
summary: The Iron Sheik takes Backlund’s championship, then loses it to Hulk Hogan. The rapid succession establishes Hogan as WWF’s new central hero.

chapters.title: Backlund loses the championship
chapters.result: The Iron Sheik defeats Bob Backlund after Arnold Skaaland throws in the towel.

chapters.title: Hogan wins his first WWF championship
chapters.result: Hulk Hogan defeats the Iron Sheik.
chapters.context: Hogan escapes the Camel Clutch and takes the championship.
